data.narrative:
Astrolight, a Seed-stage space and aerospace company founded by Laurynas Mačiulis, has raised €2.8M to date. The valuation universe comprises 5 public Space & Aerospace comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including Starcloud, SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, and Sierra Space.

Only one valuation method is reliably applicable. Stage-Progression analysis uses the €2.8M total raised as a proxy for current value, then applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for Seed-to-Series A advancement, yielding €7M. Peer-Median triangulation is inapplicable due to insufficient narrow-set comparables in the same stage and valuation tier; while 14 same-sector peers exist, only 1 qualifies at Astrolight's stage, falling short of the 3-datapoint threshold needed for statistical weight. Public-Comp Anchoring cannot be executed because Astrolight's revenue is not disclosed, and applying the 24.4x median P/S multiple from public comps would be speculative without a concrete revenue base.

The analysis supports a valuation range of €6M–€8M, with a median point of €7M. The single-method foundation and lack of revenue disclosure represent material constraints on precision. Key uncertainties include Astrolight's actual revenue run-rate, unit economics, and the applicability of pure Seed-stage step-up multiples in a sector where capital intensity and competitive dynamics may deviate materially from broader venture benchmarks.
